label: 服务器端版本记录（API）
js: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/v1/services/versions', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + getActiveToken() } }); const j = await r.json(); const s = (j.services || []).find(x => x.name === 'rs_server' || x.service === 'rs_server') || j.rs_server || j; return r.status + ' ' + JSON.stringify(s).slice(0, 600); })()
